name: github-mcp
description: Automatic vault backup to GitHub every 60 minutes

notes.what_it_does: Detects vault changes, auto-commits with descriptive message, auto-pushes to GitHub
notes.benefit: Full history of vault evolution, recovery if local machine fails
notes.default: User decides whether to enable during /vault-install

setup_instructions: 1. Create a private GitHub repo for your vault
2. Add GITHUB_TOKEN to Claude Code environment
3. Set VAULT_REPO to your repo URL
